description: Prior Authorization Form - A healthcare document submitted by a provider to a payer (insurer) requesting approval to deliver a specific service, procedure, or medication before it is performed. Typically includes patient demographics and insurance information, the requesting and servicing provider details (names, NPI, contact information), diagnosis and procedure/medication codes (ICD, CPT, HCPCS), the requested service or drug with supporting clinical justification, and dates of service. Used to confirm coverage and medical necessity prior to treatment.
